about: module infra-local's mutants (IA2): each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules infra-local). The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: ia2-file-kept-on-change
mutants.origin: wf10/domain IA2 (plan §7.5: Apply of a changed file keeps the old text)
mutants.from:
let dir = try under(id, f.base, p.Dir)
	if strings.Contains(p.Name, "/") {
mutants.rule: An Apply of a file writes it whole every time, so a changed text replaces the old: ChangedFileHoldsTheNewText.

mutants.name: ia2-delete-leaves-running
mutants.origin: wf10/domain IA2 (plan §7.5: Delete of a process leaves it running)
mutants.to:
pr.spawner.Kill(exec.Detached{Pid: 0, Start: 0, Name: r.Value.Detached.Name}, pr.grace)
		try drop(pr.ledger, "process", id)
mutants.rule: Delete ends the program's process group before it forgets the program: DeleteEndsTheProgram (Driver.DeleteIsIdempotent reads only the ledger, so it does not see this).

mutants.name: ia2-apply-respawns
mutants.rule: An Apply of the props a program runs with keeps it, so a resumed run starts nothing twice: SecondApplyKeepsTheProgram (Driver.RetrySafe compares only the attributes, which a new start gives too).

mutants.name: ia2-changed-program-kept
mutants.rule: An Apply of changed props ends the old program and starts the new one: ChangedProgramRestarts.

mutants.name: ia2-unanswered-kept
mutants.rule: A program that does not answer its health check is ended and forgotten when its Apply fails: UnansweredLeavesNothing.

mutants.name: ia2-dir-unrecorded
mutants.rule: An Apply records the directory in the ledger, so Read finds it by its id: Driver.ReadAfterApply for Dirs.

mutants.name: px6-rows-status-lost
mutants.rule: A row keeps its status, so a run finds the work a crash left: State.PutThenGet for IntRows.

mutants.name: px6-lock-shared
mutants.rule: One run at a time holds the file lock: Lock.LockExcludes for FileLock.
